User Story: As a player, I want to install the game to my home screen so that it runs full-screen and offline
Expected Behavior: manifest.json (standalone, portrait, icons), apple-touch-icon, network-first service worker caches the shell

User Story: As a player, I want rich link previews so that shared daily links look enticing
Expected Behavior: og/twitter meta give title, posse/ladder description, og-daily.jpg 1200x630 summary_large_image

User Story: As an owner, I want to unlock owner.html with a passcode so that only I can set the daily
Expected Behavior: Gate takes a password; unlock() probes a gated saveBank+deleteBank to verify; wrong shows Wrong passcode, success calls enter()

User Story: As an owner, I want the studio to remember my passcode for the session so that I dont re-enter it
Expected Behavior: enter() saves passcode to sessionStorage + localStorage pg_ownerMode=1; auto-unlock IIFE re-enters if present

User Story: As an owner, I want to pick any UTC date so that I can publish or inspect a daily ahead of time
Expected Behavior: Date input defaults to today; Tomorrow advances one UTC day; onchange triggers refreshDayStatus()

User Story: As an owner, I want to see what plays on a chosen date so that I know whether to override
Expected Behavior: refreshDayStatus fetches published daily; if none shows the date-seeded auto hole; if published shows title + Unpublish

User Story: As an owner, I want 3 brand-new procedural holes per click so that the daily is never repeated
Expected Behavior: propose() loads hidden game.html?gen=1 iframe, calls PG.__proposeWacky(3); renders name/par + Preview/Publish/Bank per hole; Reroll

User Story: As an owner, I want each generated hole to be a weird structure-packed shape so that dailies feel fresh
Expected Behavior: genWacky(seed) builds a 4-7 waypoint winding centerline, width-fn, pinch-aware obstacle plan via isl(); random name/par/mood

User Story: As an owner, I want to play-test a candidate before publishing so that I know its good
Expected Behavior: previewJson stashes hole JSON to localStorage pg_preview and opens game.html?preview=1 which loads it live

User Story: As an owner, I want a candidate verified beatable so that I never publish an impossible hole
Expected Behavior: doPublishJson runs PG.__testHole(json,10) headless bot; if beatable publishes, else confirms publish anyway

Feature: Publish a hole as the daily
User Story: As an owner, I want to set a dates daily so that all players get my chosen hole
Expected Behavior: doPublishJson calls publishDaily(pass,day,title,null,holeJson) writing hole_json to daily table; refreshes status

User Story: As an owner, I want to save a candidate without publishing so that I can schedule it later
Expected Behavior: doBankJson calls saveBank(pass,title,idx,json,forDay); banked rows render in Bank panel

User Story: As an owner, I want to manage banked holes so that I can reuse or remove them
Expected Behavior: loadBank fetches bank rows (filters __probe__); each offers Preview, Publish, Delete

User Story: As an owner, I want to publish a fresh hole for each of the next N days in one click so that a week is set fast
Expected Behavior: autoFill(7) generates N holes, tests each beatable (up to 3x), publishDaily for each consecutive UTC date; confirms overwrite

User Story: As an owner, I want to remove a published daily so that the date reverts to the auto hole
Expected Behavior: refreshDayStatus shows Unpublish calling unpublishDaily(pass, day)

User Story: As an owner, I want to see all published dailies so that I know which dates are filled
Expected Behavior: loadSched fetches the daily table and lists day + title rows

User Story: As an owner, I want live engagement stats so that I know if the daily is alive
Expected Behavior: loadEngagement shows players/plays today + 7d, teams total, live/asleep line + top-3 teams this week

User Story: As an owner, I want candidates to avoid recently published holes so that rotation stays varied
Expected Behavior: loadRecent fetches the schedule into recentIdx before the first propose

User Story: As an owner, I want hidden admin/editor tools only on my device so that players get a clean game
Expected Behavior: Boot reads ?owner=1/?edit to set pg_ownerMode; ?owner=0 clears; EDIT LEVEL + OWNER menu render only when ownerMode

User Story: As an owner, I want to jump into the editor on the current hole so that I can tweak it in place
Expected Behavior: EDIT LEVEL: draft->edEnter; built-in->editBuiltin(hi); custom->editCustom; else edEnter

User Story: As an owner, I want a quick menu of admin actions so that everything is reachable
Expected Behavior: OWNER button toggles menu: Generate daily, Daily Studio, Level Editor, Jump to hole, Reset daily, Hard reload, build label

User Story: As an owner, I want to generate/preview/edit/publish 3 holes without leaving the game so that I set the daily fast
Expected Behavior: genStudio overlay shows 3 genWacky holes with Preview, Edit, Publish-as-today, Regenerate (auto-tests then publishDaily)

User Story: As an owner, I want to load any hole by number so that I can inspect/test any level
Expected Behavior: OWNER menu prompt loads hole N (0-35) clearing daily/archive via loadHole(n)

User Story: As an owner, I want to replay or force-refresh so that I can re-test the daily
Expected Behavior: Reset clears pg_daily_done and reloads; Hard reload replaces with a cache-busting query

User Story: As an owner, I want to open any built-in hole in the editor so that I can modify the shipped layout
Expected Behavior: editBuiltin(i) loads any override or original HOLES[i](), normalizes theme/phys/turf, marks _ov=i, opens editor

User Story: As an owner, I want built-in edits to play every time so that changes are permanent on that device
Expected Behavior: edSave Save into Level #N calls saveOver(oi, edSerialize) to pg_over; builtinHole loads it; Revert clears it

User Story: As an owner, I want to deep-link into editing/previewing a hole so that the Studio can hand off
Expected Behavior: ?edit=N loads hole N then editBuiltin; ?preview loads pg_preview JSON live

User Story: As an owner, I want a 2D top-down editor so that I can place and arrange everything
Expected Behavior: edEnter/edInit build top bar, left palette (31 tools), right inspector, modal; ghost cursor + crosshair

User Story: As an owner, I want to set where the ball starts so that the hole begins where I choose
Expected Behavior: tee brush places/moves the tee; drag on map; cannot be deleted

User Story: As an owner, I want to set the hole so that players know where to sink
Expected Behavior: cup brush places/moves the cup; size set via Physics cup size; cannot be deleted

User Story: As an owner, I want to draw walls so that I can shape barriers and corridors
Expected Behavior: wall brush clicks two points; Shift snaps 45deg; Select grabs a wall-group with rounding/simplify/bounce/height

User Story: As an owner, I want to draw a freeform outline so that the green follows a wacky shape
Expected Behavior: draw brush: closed loop sets d.shape polygon + curb walls; open line makes a channel of brush width

User Story: As an owner, I want to click polygon corners so that I can make a precise custom green outline
Expected Behavior: shape brush drops corners; clicking the first ring closes -> sets d.shape + curve curb walls

User Story: As an owner, I want to draw floating islands so that I can build multi-island holes
Expected Behavior: island brush drag-draws a loop; edFinishIsland smooths (chaikin), calls d.island(poly) + curb + noBox; bounds expand

User Story: As an owner, I want one-click course shapes so that I can start from a useful layout
Expected Behavior: Shapes modal applies S-Curve, Z-Bend, W-Zigzag, Round Arena, Two/Three-Tier Drop; undoable

User Story: As an owner, I want kick pads so that the ball pings around pinball-style
Expected Behavior: bumper brush; sliders radius + bounce power

User Story: As an owner, I want a fixed-direction fling so that I can launch the ball into a loop/jump
Expected Behavior: booster brush; sliders angle, speed, radius

User Story: As an owner, I want pinball flippers so that players can flip the ball
Expected Behavior: flipL/flipR brushes; sliders length, rotation, paddle speed, flip power

User Story: As an owner, I want spinning blades so that timing matters
Expected Behavior: windmill brush; sliders radius, blades (2-8), spin

User Story: As an owner, I want a vertical loop so that the ball rides up and over
Expected Behavior: loop brush; sliders radius, angle

User Story: As an owner, I want a drop hole / slide tube so that I can build two-level holes
Expected Behavior: warp brush; radius slider; warpExit draggable to a lower tier; tube flag persisted (slide)

User Story: As an owner, I want a teleport with random exits so that shots get unpredictable
Expected Behavior: portal brush; radius; add/remove exit; 2+ exits -> random one; each exit draggable

User Story: As an owner, I want an airborne flaming ring so that players score by jumping through
Expected Behavior: firering brush; sliders radius, height off ground, points

User Story: As an owner, I want hazard creatures so that levels have moving threats
Expected Behavior: enemy brush; type (spiky/blob/ghost), behavior (patrol/chase/static), on-hit (knockback/reset/stun) + size/speed

User Story: As an owner, I want collectible coins so that I can lay scoring trails
Expected Behavior: coin brush; value slider (1-20)

User Story: As an owner, I want pickups so that players get magnet/shield/slow/gem/jump effects
Expected Behavior: powerup brush; kind select (magnet/shield/slow/gem/jump)

User Story: As an owner, I want a timed beam so that players must time their run
Expected Behavior: laser brush (2 clicks); sliders period, on-frac, phase

User Story: As an owner, I want a bar that opens/closes a gap so that timing passages exist
Expected Behavior: gate brush (2 clicks); sliders bar size, slide speed, height

User Story: As an owner, I want a drag current so that the ball is swept off-line
Expected Behavior: conveyor brush; sliders width, length, direction, strength

User Story: As an owner, I want a swinging wrecking ball so that the lane has a moving hazard
Expected Behavior: pendulum brush; sliders arm length, swing amp, speed, ball size

User Story: As an owner, I want a spinning disc so that shots curve/randomize
Expected Behavior: turntable brush; sliders radius, spin (signed direction)

User Story: As an owner, I want elevation features so that the green has slopes, bowls, jumps, multi-levels
Expected Behavior: hill (radius/height), funnel (radius/depth), ramp (start-z/end-z/height), tier (step height, neg=lower)

User Story: As an owner, I want to brush-raise/lower the ground so that I can sculpt freeform elevation
Expected Behavior: raise/lower brushes paint terrain with brush-size radius; drag to apply; undoable

User Story: As an owner, I want to grab placed items so that I can reposition, copy or remove them
Expected Behavior: select brush; drag to move; Duplicate (Ctrl+D); Delete (Del/right-click); tee/cup protected

User Story: As an owner, I want to clean up hand-drawn walls so that curves are smooth or corners sharp
Expected Behavior: Smooth (chaikin) re-traces wall chains; wall-group rounding (chaikin) + simplify (Douglas-Peucker) sliders

User Story: As an owner, I want snapping and brush sizing so that placement is precise
Expected Behavior: grid-snap ON/OFF; brush-size slider (40-520) controls draw/erase/raise/lower/island radius

User Story: As an owner, I want to set name, par, width, length, wall height, slope tilt so that the frame is configured
Expected Behavior: Inspector LEVEL: name, par, width/length/wall-height, tilt L-R / tee-cup sliders, box-vs-custom toggle

User Story: As an owner, I want to pick a terrain theme and tune physics so that the hole plays how I want
Expected Behavior: Theme select (sets physics+turf+sky/fog); sliders gravity, friction, ground/wall bounce, bumper kick, flip power, max drive, cup size

User Story: As an owner, I want to assign a lighting look so that the hole has a distinct mood
Expected Behavior: d.mood persists in serialize/deserialize; generated holes get a random mood; FX picker chooses among ~15 looks

User Story: As an owner, I want to see the level in 3D while editing so that I can judge the real look
Expected Behavior: 3D button toggles edEnter3D/edExit3D; builds live scene, camera orbit; edLiveRefresh batches rebuilds

User Story: As an owner, I want to play my draft instantly so that I can verify it before saving
Expected Behavior: TEST button (edPlay) loads the draft as a live playable hole with a TEST banner

User Story: As an owner, I want to start blank or wipe items so that I can restart cleanly
Expected Behavior: New resets to newDraft (confirm); Clear wipes placed items keeping shape/tee/cup/theme

User Story: As an owner, I want to save custom levels locally so that I can replay/manage them
Expected Behavior: edSave/edLevels store edSerialize to pg_levels; MY LEVELS modal lists, loads, renames, deletes; item counts

User Story: As an owner, I want to publish my hand-edited hole as the live daily so that custom edits reach everyone
Expected Behavior: edSave OWNER block (ownerMode+NET): date + passcode, auto-tests beatability, then publishDaily(custom json) or saveBank

User Story: As an owner, I want to export/import level JSON so that I can back up or share layouts
Expected Behavior: edExport copies/downloads edSerialize JSON; edImport pastes or file-loads JSON -> edDeserialize

User Story: As an owner, I want every element persisted so that nothing is lost on save/reload
Expected Behavior: edSerialize/edDeserialize round-trip name/par/bounds/tee/cup/walls/all obstacles/terrain/shape/islands/theme/phys/turf/mood/multiball

User Story: As an owner, I want to jot whats wrong so that the developer can fix it
Expected Behavior: Notes modal saves dated notes (with build) to pg_notes and lists past notes

User Story: As an owner, I want automated play-testing so that published holes are verified solvable
Expected Behavior: testDraftBeatable/PG.__testHole/PG.__beatN run an aiming bot up to N tries returning beatable+strokes; restores state

User Story: As an owner, I want passcode-gated backend calls so that only I can mutate dailies/bank
Expected Behavior: PGNet wraps publish_daily, unpublish_daily, save_bank, delete_bank (all take p_pass) + read-only fetchBank/fetchSchedule/engagement
